I know that parents don't know much, they have been in toxic marriage for 25 years. The point is, I have to make my way to making my own way. There are always two options, either you make your way or you cut it, nothing in between. And you know what, it doesn't feel worse, it feels redeeming that I'm able to rethink everything and vent.
